_icons.{blood}: Wound (blood-drop icon; on these cards 'this {blood}' refers to this Wound card itself)

cards.name: Breathless
cards.text:
At the end of each of your turns, lose 1 {lungs}
Losing {lungs} in this way does not incur {faceDownWound}

cards.name: Broken Battery
cards.text:
Place an {obstruction} (Obstruction) token on the highest space of your Charge track, decreasing your {charge} if necessary
You may no longer fully recover {charge}

cards.name: Claustrophobia
cards.text: You may not Lock or Open Doors

cards.name: Collapsed Lung
cards.text:
Place an {obstruction} (Obstruction) token on the highest space of your Stamina track, decreasing your {lungs} if necessary
You may no longer fully recover {lungs}

cards.name: Commiserate
cards.text: When adjacent to another Investigator, you may discard this {blood} if the other Investigator takes 2 {faceDownWound}

cards.name: Discharge
cards.text:
When you receive or flip this {blood} face-up, set your {charge} to 0
You may still gain {charge} while this {blood} is face-up
You do not regain lost {charge} if this {blood} is flipped face-down

cards.name: Dislocated Hip
cards.text: You may not travel through Map Hazards

cards.name: Disoriented
cards.text: You may not use your Major or Minor Ability

cards.name: Drain
cards.text: You may no longer take the Charge Final Action

cards.name: Dying Battery
cards.text: At the end of each of your turns, lose 1 {charge}

cards.name: Ergophobia
cards.text: You may no longer take the Involved Action {involvedAction} Final Action

cards.name: Fear
cards.text:
When you receive or flip this {blood} face-up, you must use your Major Ability on your next turn
If you do not have a {majorAbility} token (or if you are unable to use it), there is no effect
You do not get the {majorAbility} token back if this {blood} is flipped face-down

cards.name: Fractured Foot
cards.text: You have 1 less {footprint} when Moving

cards.name: Fumble
cards.text:
When you receive or flip this {blood} face-up, discard a random {item} card (and any associated tokens)
If you do not have any {item} cards, there is no effect
You do not get the {item} card back if this {blood} is flipped face-down

cards.name: Hemorrhage
cards.text: Other {faceUpWound} may not be flipped face-down until this {blood} is flipped face-down

cards.name: Mangled Hands
cards.text: You may not use {item} or {cursedItem} cards

cards.name: Mistrust
cards.text: You may not Trade or be Traded with, and you may not pick up {pointOfInterest} (Point of Interest) tokens

cards.name: Nyctophilia
cards.text:
You may no longer take the Place Flashlight Final Action
You may still gain {charge}

cards.name: Nyctophobia
cards.text:
You may not Move from a Bright or Dim space to a Dark space
You may still Move from one Dark space to another

cards.name: Panic
cards.text: You may no longer gain {lungs} as part of your Final Action, even if you choose to Rest

cards.name: Pulled Hammy
cards.text: You have 2 less {footprint} when Moving

cards.name: Punctured Lung
cards.text: {faceDownWound} gained from Sprinting are now {faceUpWound}

cards.name: Slipped Disc
cards.text:
You may carry only up to 2 total {item} and/or {cursedItem} cards
If you ever have more than 2 total {item} and/or {cursedItem} cards, choose cards to discard (along with any associated tokens) until only 2 remain

cards.name: Spasm
Torn Ligament
cards.text: Subtract 1 from your Sprint roll, down to a minimum of 1

cards.name: Tunnel Vision
cards.text: When you place your Flashlight, only the 3 center lines may be used for line of sight
